notes.title: Patch v0.2.0 Bosses Upgraded, Pickup Towers, Infinite Resource Bug Fixed
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that could result in millions of resources
- Fixed bug with racoon boss that could cause it to attack off screen


- You can now pickup towers with right click.
- You can now view stats by left clicking a tower after placing.
- More descriptions for towers.
- Less particles but same resource amounts for buildings.
- Easier to pickup resources
- Sword and Hammer towers now taunt and have high hp.
- A lot of new towers
- Lots of art/FX upgrades
- Only reported crash fixed
- Music system reworked and now transitions appropriately
- Main menu music
- Major performance improvements

notes.title: Patch v 0.1.3 Fixing Upgrades + Poison Tower
notes.content:
- Basically all upgrades were broken except for character passives.  This has been fixed.
- Poison Tower has been added to the game.  A Single Randomly Targeting stacking damage debuff that deals significant damage over time.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2 - Bugfixing Reset Upgrades
notes.content: Just fixed a bug that would cause the UI not to reload when resetting the upgrades.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1 Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that could cause a black screen
- Fixed a bug where after watching the story you would return to the main menu
- Fixed a bug where ghost menus could accidentally be clicked in the background
- Fixed a bug that could cause you to see a green "empty" screen
